declare

begin


:special_patients.patient_name := Initcap(:special_patients.pat_last_name||
 ', '||:special_patients.pat_first_name);

-- Populate patient type...e.g autologous
begin 
 Select description
 into :special_patients.pat_type_desc
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type = 'PATTY'
 and code = :special_patients.pat_type
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);
exception

 handle_error;
end;
/**
:special_patients.surg_date := :list_block.surg_id;
:special_patients.surg_id := :list_block.surg_date;
**/

-- Populate surgery date and day from transfusion detail....
begin
 select surg_date,surg_id
 into :special_patients.surg_date,:special_patients.surg_id
 from transf_details
 where pat_id = :special_patients.pat_id
 and surg_id = :list_block.surg_id
 and surg_date = :list_block.surg_date ;

 from transf_details
 where pat_id = :special_patients.pat_id)
 and rownum < 2;
**/

if :special_patients.INTL_CONTACT_PHONE_NO is not null then
 :special_patients.INTL_CONTACT_PHONE_NO := :special_patients.INTL_CONTACT_PHONE_NO;
else
 :special_patients.INTL_CONTACT_PHONE_NO := :special_patients.CONTACT_AREA_CODE||' '||:special_patients.CONTACT_PHONE_NO;
end if;
--
exception
 when no_data_found then
 null;

end;

end;

procedure generate_report (p_report_name IN varchar2,
 p_parm_id IN varchar2,
 p_chapter_id IN varchar2,
 p_appl_id IN varchar2,
 p_desformat IN varchar2,
 p_destype IN varchar2,
 p_no_of_copies IN varchar2,
 p_print_id IN varchar2,
 p_HEADER_YN IN varchar2,
 p_DELETE_AFTER_PRINT_FLAG IN VARCHAR2,
 p_AUTO_PRINT_FLAG IN VARCHAR2,
 P_status OUT varchar2
 ) is
 parameters VARCHAR2(150) := NULL;
 batch_queue rpt_report_names.batch_queue%type;
 temp_return number;
 x varchar2(1);
 filename varchar2(100);
 pl_id ParamList; 
 pl_name VARCHAR2(10) := 'dest_parm'; 
 rep_dir valid_parameters.parameter_value%type;
 repoutput_dir valid_parameters.parameter_value%type;

Begin
/*
 * Check if Report request is submitted - in rpt_parm table
 */
 BEGIN
 select 'x' 
 into x
 from rpt_parm
 where report_name = p_report_name
 and user_name = LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid
 and parm_id = p_parm_id
 and appl_id = p_appl_id;
 EXCEPTION
 When no_data_found then
 p_status := 'Report Not Submitted';
 return;
 When others then
 p_status := substr(sqlerrm,1,100);
 return;
 END;
/*
 * Get Report executables Directory i.e *.REP source files
 */
 begin
 select parameter_value 
 into rep_dir 
 from valid_parameters
 where parameter_code = 'REPSOURCE' 
 and parameter_type = 'ALL'
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);
 exception
 when others then
 p_status :='REPSOURCE parameter not defined: Contact IS';
 --RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 return;
 end;
/*
 * Get Report Output Directory i.e where *.r files will be written
 */
 begin
 select parameter_value 
 into repoutput_dir 
 from valid_parameters
 where parameter_code = 'REPOUTPUT'
 and parameter_type = 'ALL'
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);
 exception
 when others then
 p_status := 'REPOUTPUT parameter not defined: Contact IS';
 return;
 end;
/*
 * Make output file name 
 */
 filename := repoutput_dir||p_report_name||'_'||p_parm_id||'_'||LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid||'.r';
/*
 * Generate Parameter List
 */
 begin 
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF not Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 destroy_parameter_list(pl_id) ;
 end if ;
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 p_status := 'Error creating parameter list '||pl_name;
 return;
 END IF; 
 end; 
/*
 * ADD Parameters to the parameter list
 */
 add_parameter(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,p_destype);
 add_parameter(pl_id,'DESNAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,filename) ;
 add_parameter(pl_id,'DESFORMAT',TEXT_PARAMETER,p_desformat);
 add_parameter(pl_id,'P_PARM_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER, p_parm_id ) ;
 add_parameter(pl_id,'NO_OF_COPIES',TEXT_PARAMETER,p_no_of_copies);
 add_parameter(pl_id,'P_CHAPTER_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,nvl(p_chapter_id,'WAD'));
 add_parameter(pl_id,'PRINT_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,p_print_id);
 add_parameter(pl_id,'HEADER_YN',TEXT_PARAMETER,p_header_yn);
 add_parameter(pl_id,'DELETE_AFTER_PRINT_FLAG',TEXT_PARAMETER,p_DELETE_AFTER_PRINT_FLAG);
 add_parameter(pl_id,'AUTO_PRINT_FLAG',TEXT_PARAMETER,p_AUTO_PRINT_FLAG);
/*
 * RUN ORACLE REPORTS PRODUCT
 */
 rp2rro.rp2rro_run_product(REPORTS,rep_dir||p_report_name,ASYNCHRONOUS,BATCH,FILESYSTEM,pl_id,null);
 p_status := 'OK';
End ;

PROCEDURE Query_Master_Details(rel_id Relation,detail VARCHAR2) IS

ProgramUnit.Name: CLEAR_ALL_MASTER_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Clear_All_Master_Details IS
 mastblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Initial Master Block Cusing Coord
 coordop VARCHAR2(30); -- Operation Causing the Coord
 trigblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Cur Block On-Clear-Details Fires On
 startitm VARCHAR2(61); -- Item in which cursor started
 frmstat VARCHAR2(15); -- Form Status
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 curdtl VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Detail Block

 FUNCTION First_Changed_Block_Below(Master VARCHAR2)
 RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 retblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Return Block
 BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Vars
 --
 curblk := Master;
 currel := Get_Block_Property(curblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 --
 -- While there exists another relation for this block
 --
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 --
 -- Get the name of the detail block
 --
 curblk := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 --
 -- If this block has changes, return its name
 --
 IF ( Get_Block_Property(curblk, STATUS) IN('CHANGED','INSERT') ) THEN
 RETURN curblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- No changes, recursively look for changed blocks below
 --
 retblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(curblk);
 --
 -- If some block below is changed, return its name
 --
 IF retblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 RETURN retblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Consider the next relation
 --
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- No changed blocks were found
 --
 RETURN NULL;
 END First_Changed_Block_Below;

BEGIN
 --
 -- Init Local Vars
 --
 mastblk := :System.Master_Block;
 coordop := :System.Coordination_Operation;
 trigblk := :System.Trigger_Block;
 startitm := :System.Trigger_Item;
 frmstat := :System.Form_Status;

 --
 -- If the coordination operation is anything but CLEAR_RECORD or
 -- SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS, then continue checking.
 --
 IF coordop NOT IN ('CLEAR_RECORD', 'SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS') THEN
 --
 -- If we're processing the driving master block...
 --
 IF mastblk = trigblk THEN
 --
 -- If something in the form is changed, find the
 -- first changed block below the master
 --
 IF frmstat = 'CHANGED' THEN
 curblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(mastblk);
 --
 -- If we find a changed block below, go there
 -- and Ask to commit the changes.
 --
 IF curblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 Go_Block(curblk);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(ASK_COMMIT);
 --
 -- If user cancels commit dialog, raise error
 --
 IF NOT ( :System.Form_Status = 'QUERY'
 OR :System.Block_Status = 'NEW' ) THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 --
 -- Clear all the detail blocks for this master without
 -- any further asking to commit.
 --
 currel := Get_Block_Property(trigblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 curdtl := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 IF Get_Block_Property(curdtl, STATUS) <> 'NEW' THEN
 Go_Block(curdtl);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(NO_VALIDATE);
 IF :System.Block_Status <> 'NEW' THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- Put cursor back where it started
 --
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 END IF;
 RAISE;

END Clear_All_Master_Details;
